scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && npm --prefix packages/models run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/verify-web-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/models run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs packages/models/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.harness:init: npm run build && node dist/entrypoints/harness-main.js init
